description: THE TABLES OF ONE EU ACT: for each, its handle, the title the act stores for it, its size, its column names and its first rows. Use it when a regulation, directive or decision keeps its substance in a table: the CN codes of a list of goods, a list of persons under restrictive measures, a quota or a limit-value table, an annex of a classification of substances. lookup_eu_article and get_eu_act_structure read articles and the text of annexes and do not carry the cells of a table. Give the act's CELEX (a base CELEX is followed to the consolidated version in force, and the answer says so). Then read a table with read_eu_table or search inside it with search_eu_tables. The answer says how many tables of the act have no cells in the database, and when a table is tied to no annex or article.

celex.description: The EU act that holds the tables: its CELEX, e.g. '32014R0833' (a base act: it is followed to the consolidated version in force, and the answer says so) or '02014R0833-20260717' (that exact version).

offset.description: Tables to skip (the answer says what to send for the next page).

part.description: Optional. Only the tables whose title or place in the act contains this text, diacritics ignored, e.g. 'anexa XIV' or 'persoane'.

name: list_eu_tables
